sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: For the past decade, a simple message has been delivered to a generation of American students.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年里，一个简单的信息被传达给了美国的一代学生。

sentences.en: If you learn to code and get a computer science degree, then you'll get a job with a six-figure salary.
sentences.zh: 如果你学习编程并获得计算机科学学位，你就能找到一份六位数薪水的工作。

sentences.en: But as my colleague, Natasha Singer, found out, thousands of students who followed that advice are discovering that the promise was empty.
sentences.zh: 但正如我的同事娜塔莎·辛格所发现的那样，成千上万听从这一建议的学生发现，这个承诺是空洞的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月29日，星期一。

sentences.en: Natasha.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莎。

sentences.en: Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming back on the show.
sentences.zh: 感谢你再次来到节目中。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: You, Natasha, came to us with a counterintuitive observation, which is that at this moment that on paper seems like a highly lucrative opportunity in the world of tech
sentences.zh: 娜塔莎，你带给我们一个反直觉的观察，那就是在当下这个纸面上看起来是科技界极具诱惑力的机会时刻，

sentences.en: because of the boom in artificial intelligence,
sentences.zh: 由于人工智能的繁荣，

sentences.en: this moment is turning out to be a bust for those recent college grads trying to get into the tech industry.
sentences.zh: 这一时刻对于那些试图进入科技行业的应届大学毕业生来说，却变成了一场泡沫。

sentences.en: That's unexpected.
sentences.zh: 这出乎意料。

sentences.en: It's completely unexpected.
sentences.zh: 完全出乎意料。

sentences.en: We've seen over the last two years a kind of remarkable spike in unemployment among recent college grads seeking software engineering and other tech jobs.
sentences.zh: 在过去两年里，我们看到寻求软件工程和其他科技职位的应届大学毕业生失业率出现了惊人的飙升。

sentences.en: And let me give you some numbers just to illustrate that.
sentences.zh: 让我提供一些数据来说明这一点。

sentences.en: Among recent college grads, age 22 to 27, computer science and computer engineering majors are facing some of the highest unemployment rates, 6.1% and 7.5% respectively,
sentences.zh: 根据纽约联邦储备银行的这份新报告，在22至27岁的应届大学毕业生中，计算机科学和计算机工程专业的学生面临着最高的失业率，分别为6.1%和7.5%。

sentences.en: according to this new report from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
sentences.zh: 根据纽约联邦储备银行的这份新报告。

sentences.en: And what does that compare with everybody else?
sentences.zh: 这与其他专业相比如何？

sentences.en: That's more than twice the unemployment rate among recent biology grads, which is just 3%.
sentences.zh: 这比生物学应届毕业生的失业率（仅为3%）高出两倍多。

sentences.en: College grads with tech backgrounds, the lottery ticket, or so we thought, in American life, are having a harder time getting jobs than biology majors.
sentences.zh: 拥有科技背景的大学毕业生，也就是我们曾经认为的“彩票中奖者”，在美国生活中找工作反而比生物学专业的学生更难。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as a reporter who spent more than a decade studying Silicon Valley's influence on American education,
sentences.zh: 作为一名研究硅谷对美国教育影响超过十年的记者，

sentences.en: I can say that, like, the reduced job prospects for computer science grads this year represents a stunning breakdown in the promise that tech executives have made
sentences.zh: 我可以肯定地说，今年计算机科学专业毕业生就业前景的缩减，代表了科技高管们过去十年里对数百万美国学生所作承诺的彻底破灭。

sentences.en: to millions of American school kids over the last decade.
sentences.zh: 对数百万美国学生所作承诺的彻底破灭。

sentences.en: Well, just describe what exactly was that promise, and how did it filter through the entire system?
sentences.zh: 那么，请描述一下那个承诺究竟是什么，它是如何渗透到整个系统中的？

sentences.en: Silicon Valley's promise to kids was, If you just work hard and learn to code, computer programming will be your golden ticket
sentences.zh: 硅谷对孩子们的承诺是：只要你努力学习编程，计算机编程就会成为你的“黄金入场券”，

sentences.en: to a high-paying, high-powered, high-status tech job, and you will be more or less set for life.
sentences.zh: 让你获得一份高薪、高权、高地位的科技工作，从此生活无忧。

sentences.en: In the early 2010s, we see tech leaders begin to publicly warn that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在2010年代初，我们看到科技领袖们开始公开警告，美国的

sentences.en: economic might and global technology leadership is at risk because not enough high schools are teaching computer science and not enough students were studying computer programming.
sentences.zh: 经济实力和全球技术领导地位正处于危险之中，因为没有足够的高中教授计算机科学，也没有足够的学生学习计算机编程。

sentences.en: I remember those warnings.
sentences.zh: 我记得那些警告。

sentences.en: They were kind of explicit.
sentences.zh: 它们相当明确。

sentences.en: Asia, in particular places like India, they were doing a much better job of training their future, their young people, for this industry than the U.S.
sentences.zh: 亚洲，特别是像印度这样的地方，在为这个行业培养未来人才方面，比美国做得好得多。

sentences.en: We had to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 我们必须对此采取行动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's urgent.
sentences.zh: 这很紧迫。

sentences.en: The national economic prowess and technology leadership is at stake.
sentences.zh: 国家的经济实力和技术领导地位岌岌可危。

sentences.en: And so you see tech company leaders like Eric Schmidt at Google and Brad Smith at Microsoft
sentences.zh: 于是你看到像谷歌的埃里克·施密特和微软的布拉德·史密斯这样的科技公司领袖，

sentences.en: start saying that their companies are creating new tech jobs faster than they can find skilled workers to fill them.
sentences.zh: 开始说他们的公司创造新科技岗位的速度，快于他们找到熟练工人填补这些岗位的速度。

sentences.en: And then the tech companies begin lobbying members of Congress and state lawmakers to support elevating the status of computer science in schools, funding more teacher training,
sentences.zh: 随后，科技公司开始游说国会议员和州立法者，支持提升计算机科学在学校的地位，资助更多的教师培训，

sentences.en: getting more curriculuMs.
sentences.zh: 引入更多的课程。

sentences.en: Along the way, they're beginning to say,
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，他们开始说，

sentences.en: By the way, these are great jobs.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这些都是很棒的工作。

sentences.en: They're interesting jobs.
sentences.zh: 它们是很有趣的工作。

sentences.en: They're powerful jobs.
sentences.zh: 它们是很有权势的工作。

sentences.en: And then in 2013, you get Hadi Partovi, who is a well-known tech entrepreneur in Seattle,
sentences.zh: 然后在2013年，哈迪·帕托维出现了，他是西雅图一位著名的科技企业家，

sentences.en: who had started his career at Microsoft and then became an investor in companies like Uber and Dropbox.
sentences.zh: 他曾在微软开始职业生涯，后来成为优步和Dropbox等公司的投资者。

sentences.en: He comes along and he starts a new nonprofit group called Code.org to promote coding in schools.
sentences.zh: 他发起了一个名为Code.org的新非营利组织，旨在促进学校的编程教育。

sentences.en: And although it's an education nonprofit, it acts very much like a startup with viral marketing methods.
sentences.zh: 虽然它是一个教育类非营利组织，但它的运作方式非常像一家利用病毒式营销手段的初创公司。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: Well, the first thing they do to promote coding in schools is Code.org made a video in 2013.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们推广学校编程的第一件事，就是Code.org在2013年制作了一段视频。

sentences.en: I was 13 when I first got access to a computer.
sentences.zh: 我13岁时第一次接触到电脑。

sentences.en: Starring the biggest tech titans of them all, including Bill Gates and Mark Zuckerberg.
sentences.zh: 由当时最伟大的科技巨头们主演，包括比尔·盖茨和马克·扎克伯格。

sentences.en: I was in sixth grade.
sentences.zh: 我当时上六年级。

sentences.en: It just started off because I wanted to do this one simple thing.
sentences.zh: 一切的开始只是因为我想做这一件简单的事情。

sentences.en: I wanted to make something that was fun for myself and my sisters.
sentences.zh: 我想为自己和姐妹们做点有趣的东西。

sentences.en: And it opens with them talking about how they got started learning to code.
sentences.zh: 视频开头是他们讲述自己是如何开始学习编程的。

sentences.en: I wrote this little program and then basically just add a little bit to it.
sentences.zh: 我写了这个小程序，然后基本上只是在上面加了一点东西。

sentences.en: And then when I needed to learn something new, I looked it up.
sentences.zh: 当我需要学习新东西时，我就去查资料。

sentences.en: And you have these powerful billionaires making this pitch that anyone actually can learn to code.
sentences.zh: 你看到这些强大的亿万富翁在推销说，任何人其实都可以学习编程。

sentences.en: Any kid.
sentences.zh: 任何孩子。

sentences.en: Whether you're trying to make a lot of money or whether you just want to change the world, computer programming is an incredibly empowering skill to learn.
sentences.zh: 无论你是想赚大钱，还是只想改变世界，计算机编程都是一项极其赋能的技能。

sentences.en: These are our heroic innovators.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们的英雄创新者。

sentences.en: And they're rich and they've achieved the American dream.
sentences.zh: 他们富有，实现了美国梦。

sentences.en: And they're telling every kid in America, you could be us if you just learned to code.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉美国每一个孩子：只要你学习编程，你就能成为我们。

sentences.en: And by the way, we'll hire you.
sentences.zh: 而且顺便说一句，我们会雇佣你。

sentences.en: Like, what's better than that?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比这更好的呢？

sentences.en: The programmers of tomorrow are the wizards of the future.
sentences.zh: 明天的程序员就是未来的巫师。

sentences.en: You know, you're going to look like you have magic powers compared to everybody else.
sentences.zh: 你知道，与其他人相比，你会看起来拥有魔法力量。

sentences.en: It's amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太神奇了。

sentences.en: I think it's the closest thing we have to a superpower.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们所拥有的最接近超能力的东西。

sentences.en: And how much does this actually infiltrate, maybe it sounds like too aggressive a word, but become institutionalized in schools during this period?
sentences.zh: 那么，在这一时期，这实际上渗透到了什么程度——也许“渗透”这个词听起来太激进了——它在学校里变得制度化了吗？

sentences.en: You know, the video was very influential.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那段视频非常有影响力。

sentences.en: Millions of people saw this video in the first couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 在最初的几周里，数百万人观看了这段视频。

sentences.en: And I think it also, you know, just the idea that coding is you give computers an instruction of what to do.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，仅仅是“编程就是给计算机下达指令”这个概念，

sentences.en: In many families with school-age kids, this video helped coding become a household word.
sentences.zh: 在许多有学龄儿童的家庭中，这段视频帮助编程成为了家喻户晓的词汇。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Leah.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是莉亚。

sentences.en: And I'm Tanya.
sentences.zh: 我是坦尼娅。

sentences.en: And we're lucky enough to be studying computer science.
sentences.zh: 我们很幸运能学习计算机科学。

sentences.en: And then later that year, code.org launches another thing called Hour of Code.
sentences.zh: 那年晚些时候，Code.org发起了另一项名为“编程一小时”的活动。

sentences.en: How do you get him to get to the sunflower?
sentences.zh: 你如何让他到达向日葵那里？

sentences.en: He needs to do some actions.
sentences.zh: 他需要做一些动作。

sentences.en: I got it.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: And that was an annual event in schools where millions of kids simultaneously did these hour-long coding tutorials.
sentences.zh: 那是一项在学校举办的年度活动，数百万孩子同时进行这些一小时的编程教程。

sentences.en: So she coded this.
sentences.zh: 所以她编写了这个程序。

sentences.en: Look at all that code.
sentences.zh: 看看那些代码。

sentences.en: Look at all that stuff going on.
sentences.zh: 看看那些正在运行的东西。

sentences.en: Way to go!
sentences.zh: 干得好！

sentences.en: Code.org!
sentences.zh: Code.org!

sentences.en: And that was also widely influential.
sentences.zh: 那也产生了广泛的影响。

sentences.en: Because it was fun.
sentences.zh: 因为它很有趣。

sentences.en: It was easy.
sentences.zh: 它很简单。

sentences.en: And your whole school could do it at once.
sentences.zh: 而且你们整个学校可以同时进行。

sentences.en: And, you know, since that launch in 2012, code.org says that kids have done these lessons, or started them anyway, hundreds of millions of times.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，自2012年启动以来，Code.org称孩子们已经完成了这些课程，或者至少开始了这些课程，次数达数亿之多。

sentences.en: I just got an award for completing an Hour of Code.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚因为完成“编程一小时”获得了一个奖项。

sentences.en: And it says, and this is for Minecraft, and this is from Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，这是针对《我的世界》的，由微软提供。

sentences.en: Here you guys go.
sentences.zh: 给你们。

sentences.en: What happened after the video and the Hour of Code, or as these things are happening, was companies like Microsoft and Google, together with code.org,
sentences.zh: 在视频和“编程一小时”之后，或者说在这些事情发生的同时，微软和谷歌等公司与Code.org一起，

sentences.en: and dozens of national and local nonprofit groups across the country, began an effort to scale computer science in schools.
sentences.zh: 以及全国数十个地方性非营利组织，开始了一项在学校推广计算机科学的努力。

sentences.en: And they used different methods.
sentences.zh: 他们使用了不同的方法。

sentences.en: One was they did lobby from state to state and get laws passed to elevate the status of computer science.
sentences.zh: 一种是他们在各州进行游说，通过法律来提升计算机科学的地位。

sentences.en: Instead of, like, making an elective, it's now a core science course.
sentences.zh: 它不再是选修课，而是核心科学课程。

sentences.en: They got money, and they started programs to train thousands of more teachers to teach computer science.
sentences.zh: 他们获得了资金，并启动了培训数千名教师教授计算机科学的项目。

sentences.en: And they launched new curriculums in schools.
sentences.zh: 他们还在学校推出了新的课程。

sentences.en: You see, for example, in 2016, the college board launched a new advanced placement course that was funded by the National Science Foundation,
sentences.zh: 例如，在2016年，大学理事会推出了由国家科学基金会资助的新的大学先修课程（AP课程），

sentences.en: and it was called Computer Science Principles.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“计算机科学原理”。

sentences.en: It was made to broaden the audience of kids who could participate in computer science.
sentences.zh: 它的目的是扩大能够参与计算机科学学习的孩子群体。

sentences.en: And it has been wildly successful in terms of getting a huge number of kids to take this introductory on-ramp to computer science and just get a taste of what it means.
sentences.zh: 在吸引大量孩子参加这个计算机科学入门课程并体验其意义方面，它取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: And so, Natasha, as all of this focus on coding, basically coding mania, settles over America and American education, how well kept is the promise in this period?
sentences.zh: 那么，娜塔莎，随着所有这些对编程的关注——基本上是“编程狂热”——席卷美国和美国教育界，这一时期的承诺兑现得如何？

sentences.en: How well is it working out for the students who are going through it and the companies who are promoting it?
sentences.zh: 对于正在经历这一过程的学生和正在推广这一理念的公司来说，情况如何？

sentences.en: I think both the massive marketing and the increased availability of computer science in high schools helped spur a massive influx of kids to get into computer science.
sentences.zh: 我认为大规模的营销和高中计算机科学课程的普及，共同推动了大量孩子涌入计算机科学领域。

sentences.en: And we can see from the data, last year, the number of undergraduates majoring in computer science in the United States topped 170,000 students.
sentences.zh: 我们可以从数据中看到，去年，美国计算机科学专业的本科生人数超过了17万人。

sentences.en: And that is essentially triple the number of students majoring in computer science since 2012.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是2012年以来计算机科学专业学生人数的三倍。

sentences.en: It worked.
sentences.zh: 它奏效了。

sentences.en: It worked.
sentences.zh: 它奏效了。

sentences.en: I mean, getting more kids to care about this and be interested in this, want to major in it, consider careers in this, really, really worked.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，让更多的孩子关心并对这个领域感兴趣，想要主修它，考虑从事相关职业，确实非常非常有效。

sentences.en: And for certain kids who followed the pipeline through AP computer science and graduated from some of the elite schools that tech companies like to hire from,
sentences.zh: 对于那些通过AP计算机科学课程并从科技公司青睐的精英学校毕业的特定学生来说，

sentences.en: they did end up with these golden ticket jobs, doing interesting work on high profile software and making a lot of money,
sentences.zh: 他们最终确实得到了那些“黄金入场券”工作，从事高知名度软件的有趣工作，并赚了很多钱，

sentences.en: much more than humanities majors who are starting out with hourly jobs.
sentences.zh: 比那些从时薪工作开始的人文专业毕业生要多得多。

sentences.en: Okay,
sentences.zh: 好的，

sentences.en: so how do we go from these companies telling everyone there's a golden ticket to a lot of kids going out and seeking the education that would give them the golden ticket to this moment that numerically you described at the beginning of our conversation where so many computer science students can't seem to find a job and are doing worse than their classmates?
sentences.zh: 那么我们是如何从这些公司告诉每个人有“黄金入场券”，到大量孩子去寻求能给他们带来这张入场券的教育，再到你谈话开始时用数字描述的这一时刻——即如此多的计算机科学学生似乎找不到工作，表现甚至不如他们的同学？

sentences.en: How did that happen?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: So there's a confluence of factors.
sentences.zh: 这有多种因素共同作用。

sentences.en: First of all, it turns out that some of the same big tech companies who pushed schools to teach computer science and told kids coding was magic are very picky about who they hire.
sentences.zh: 首先，事实证明，一些推动学校教授计算机科学并告诉孩子们编程是魔法的大型科技公司，在招聘时非常挑剔。

sentences.en: And many of the young students who studied programming or software development really had no shot working at big tech firMs.
sentences.zh: 许多学习编程或软件开发的年轻学生，实际上根本没有机会进入大型科技公司工作。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Because the hiring process at some companies has long skewed to kids who are already advantaged to begin with.
sentences.zh: 因为一些公司的招聘流程长期以来一直偏向于那些已经处于优势地位的孩子。

sentences.en: Like some of the hiring criteria, you have to pass these coding tests.
sentences.zh: 比如一些招聘标准，你必须通过这些编程测试。

sentences.en: They're looking for students who have done side coding projects and built their own software.
sentences.zh: 他们寻找的是那些已经做过课外编程项目并构建过自己软件的学生。

sentences.en: And some of those criteria are more easily met by middle and upper class students who have money and time than lower income students who have to work full time jobs during school.
sentences.zh: 而其中一些标准，拥有金钱和时间的中上层阶级学生比那些在校期间必须做全职工作的低收入学生更容易满足。

sentences.en: And so it has always been hard for certain students to get hired by big tech companies.
sentences.zh: 所以，某些学生一直很难被大型科技公司录用。

sentences.en: So that's one of the major factors.
sentences.zh: 这就是主要因素之一。

sentences.en: Other factors that have come up more recently is that tech companies overhired during the pandemic and now some are shedding jobs.
sentences.zh: 最近出现的其他因素是，科技公司在疫情期间过度招聘，现在一些公司正在裁员。

sentences.en: We also saw that some of the big tech companies over the last couple of years, like Amazon and Microsoft,
sentences.zh: 我们还看到，过去几年里，像亚马逊和微软这样的一些大型科技公司，

sentences.en: have increased the number of foreign workers they hired because they can be paid less in some cases than Americans.
sentences.zh: 增加了他们雇佣的外国员工数量，因为在某些情况下，他们的薪水可以比美国人低。

sentences.en: And recently, the Trump administration actually tried to limit the visas that go to these workers in part to address this.
sentences.zh: 最近，特朗普政府实际上试图限制发给这些工人的签证，部分原因就是为了解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is the recent policy to increase the cost of what are known as H-1B visas.
sentences.zh: 这是最近关于提高所谓H-1B签证成本的政策。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So there's the visa issue already.
sentences.zh: 所以签证问题已经存在了。

sentences.en: And then AI comes along and that changes a number of things.
sentences.zh: 然后人工智能出现了，这改变了很多事情。

sentences.en: First of all, big tech companies have changed priorities.
sentences.zh: 首先，大型科技公司改变了优先事项。

sentences.en: They want to invest more in building these huge data centers that they need to run AI services.
sentences.zh: 他们想投入更多资金来建设运行人工智能服务所需的大型数据中心。

sentences.en: And that means less is going to go to humans on the workforce.
sentences.zh: 这意味着投入到人力资源上的资金减少了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So they're cutting back on that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正在削减这方面的开支。

sentences.en: And then the AI itself is beginning to replace workers.
sentences.zh: 而且人工智能本身也开始取代工人。

sentences.en: We saw Salesforce announce, you know, they're laying off thousands of customer service workers because AI can do some of those jobs, but also in software engineering itself.
sentences.zh: 我们看到Salesforce宣布，他们正在裁掉数千名客户服务人员，因为人工智能可以完成其中一些工作，在软件工程领域也是如此。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: AI literally codes.
sentences.zh: 人工智能确实在编写代码。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I went to visit Anthropic when I was in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我在旧金山时去参观了Anthropic公司。

sentences.en: You know, they make the AI tool Claude and they have Claude Code, you know, which generates code.
sentences.zh: 他们开发了人工智能工具Claude，还有Claude Code，可以生成代码。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，

sentences.en: they were talking about everybody coming to terms with the fact that being a software engineer is changing and that producing the code yourself is no longer the backbone of some of these jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到每个人都在接受这样一个事实：软件工程师的角色正在改变，亲自编写代码不再是这些工作的主干。

sentences.en: And, you know, that is a particular hardship for kids who've just spent the last decade learning how to master computer programming.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于那些过去十年一直在学习如何精通计算机编程的孩子们来说，这是一种特别的打击。

sentences.en: And so what exactly happens to the tens and I guess almost hundreds of thousands of kids who have built their entire academic lives around preparing for a market that for all the reasons you just described has shrunk and may not exist for them anymore?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于成千上万，甚至可以说是近十万为了一个市场而规划了整个学术生涯的孩子们来说，到底发生了什么？因为你刚才描述的所有原因，这个市场已经萎缩，可能不再为他们提供机会了。

sentences.en: So as part of my reporting on this, we asked recent computer science grads around the country to share their experiences with us.
sentences.zh: 作为我相关报道的一部分，我们邀请了全国各地的计算机科学专业应届毕业生与我们分享他们的经历。

sentences.en: And we heard from more than a hundred recent college computer science grads.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了超过一百名大学计算机科学应届毕业生的反馈。

sentences.en: And I'm just going to read you some of their responses.
sentences.zh: 我打算读给你们听听他们的一些回应。

sentences.en: They said, it's extremely discouraging.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这让人极其沮丧。

sentences.en: It's incredibly frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这令人难以置信地挫败。

sentences.en: It is soul crushing.
sentences.zh: 这简直让人心碎。

sentences.en: It seems like my degree doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 看起来我的学位毫无意义。

sentences.en: Some of my skills are now worthless.
sentences.zh: 我的一些技能现在一文不值。

sentences.en: It's too demoralizing.
sentences.zh: 这太让人丧气了。

sentences.en: Some students told us that while they're looking for tech jobs, some of them are applying for fast food jobs at Chipotle.
sentences.zh: 一些学生告诉我们，当他们在寻找科技工作时，有些人甚至在申请Chipotle的快餐店工作。

sentences.en: One student was working as a clerk at Walgreens.
sentences.zh: 有一名学生在Walgreens做店员。

sentences.en: It's not the kind of job they envisioned when they were told if they just learned to code, they'd get six-figure jobs.
sentences.zh: 这并不是他们当初被告知“只要学会编程就能拿到六位数薪水”时所设想的工作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's not the golden ticket.
sentences.zh: 那不是通往成功的金钥匙。

sentences.en: It's no longer the golden ticket.
sentences.zh: 它不再是金钥匙了。

sentences.en: It's the tarnished ticket.
sentences.zh: 它是生锈的钥匙。

sentences.en: And some of these students ended up moving back home, rich in degrees, poor in employment.
sentences.zh: 有些学生最终搬回了家，拥有高学历，却找不到工作。

sentences.en: And when I called them, they were applying for jobs out of their childhood bedrooMs.
sentences.zh: 当我给他们打电话时，他们正躺在儿时的卧室里申请工作。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的Connections游戏。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Azersky，我每天负责创作Spelling Bee和Letterboxd游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Natasha, tell us the story of one of these recent college grads majoring in computer science
sentences.zh: 那么，Natasha，给我们讲讲其中一位计算机科学专业的应届毕业生的故事吧，

sentences.en: whose visions of a career in tech have been challenged by the new reality of the industry.
sentences.zh: 他的科技职业愿景受到了行业新现实的挑战。

sentences.en: So I'm from Chagrin Falls, Ohio, up near Cleveland, northeaSt.
sentences.zh: 我来自俄亥俄州的Chagrin Falls，靠近东北部的克利夫兰。

sentences.en: One of the recent grads I spoke with whose story really resonated for me is named Nathan Spencer.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一位应届毕业生，他的故事让我感触颇深，他叫Nathan Spencer。

sentences.en: And he's 22.
sentences.zh: 他今年22岁。

sentences.en: And he grew up in a small town outside of Cleveland.
sentences.zh: 他在克利夫兰郊外的一个小镇长大。

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我想想。

sentences.en: I probably first encountered a computer through those big boxy family computers, probably when I was in middle school.
sentences.zh: 我第一次接触电脑可能是在初中时，通过那些笨重的大箱式家用电脑。

sentences.en: And he enters school just as this coding careers promise is becoming entrenched in American popular culture and education.
sentences.zh: 他进入学校时，正是编程职业的承诺在美国家庭文化和教育中根深蒂固的时候。

sentences.en: Everybody is on computers.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在用电脑。

sentences.en: I mean, we were introduced to, like, the Google suite and, like, writing on a computer, like, in fifth grade and middle school.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们在五年级和初中时就开始接触Google套件，学习在电脑上写作。

sentences.en: And he talks about watching some of the videos we talked about earlier and the hour of code and learning coding basics in middle school.
sentences.zh: 他谈到观看我们之前讨论过的一些视频，以及在初中学习编程基础知识和“编程一小时”活动。

sentences.en: Yeah, probably first experience block coding, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，可能第一次体验是积木编程，没错。

sentences.en: And as he enters high school, his interest and his learning in computer science deepens.
sentences.zh: 随着他进入高中，他对计算机科学的兴趣和学习不断加深。

sentences.en: The AP course I took, a lot of that was focused on games.
sentences.zh: 我修的AP课程，很多都专注于游戏开发。

sentences.en: We made Minesweeper.
sentences.zh: 我们制作了扫雷。

sentences.en: We collaboratively as a class made, like, a dungeon crawler board game.
sentences.zh: 我们全班合作制作了一个地牢探险棋盘游戏。

sentences.en: I made Tetris for my final project.
sentences.zh: 我的期末项目是制作了俄罗斯方块。

sentences.en: And as a high school senior, he takes an AP computer science class, and it ends up being a really formative experience.
sentences.zh: 作为一名高中生，他选修了AP计算机科学课程，这最终成为了一次非常有启发性的经历。

sentences.en: He said he had a really great teacher who taught him a lot.
sentences.zh: 他说他遇到了一位非常棒的老师，教了他很多东西。

sentences.en: I think that's kind of where that interest sparked was we'd make a game and then my teacher would drop something like,
sentences.zh: 我想这就是兴趣被点燃的地方，我们会做一个游戏，然后老师会随口说，

sentences.en: oh, like, did you know that everything that you're working with is actually just stored in, like,
sentences.zh: “哦，你知道吗，你所处理的一切其实都只是存储在，比如，

sentences.en: a binary code and everything's just on and off and it's all just electrical switches.
sentences.zh: 二进制代码中，一切都只是开和关，全都是电子开关。”

sentences.en: But along the way, he discovers he loves programming.
sentences.zh: 但在学习过程中，他发现自己热爱编程。

sentences.en: He loves being able to make stuff with code.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢用代码创造东西的感觉。

sentences.en: It's not just the promise of money.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是为了钱的承诺。

sentences.en: It's the promise of making stuff.
sentences.zh: 这是创造事物的承诺。

sentences.en: It really does feel like he is a true product of the world that these tech company leaders created within American education.
sentences.zh: 他确实感觉自己是这些科技公司领导者在美国教育体系中创造的世界的真正产物。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He seems like he is the ideal person for the pipeline that the tech industry is building.
sentences.zh: 他看起来像是科技行业正在建立的人才输送管道的理想人选。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So then he goes to college at Ohio State.
sentences.zh: 后来他去了俄亥俄州立大学读书。

sentences.en: And I kind of thought back in that moment to how much I enjoyed programming, how much I enjoyed creating on a computer.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我回想起自己是多么喜欢编程，多么喜欢在电脑上创作。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay, I'll pivot to computer science.
sentences.zh: 于是我想，好吧，我要转到计算机科学专业。

sentences.en: And after a brief moment as a math major, he decides to switch to the field that he loves, computer science.
sentences.zh: 在短暂修读数学专业后，他决定转到他热爱的领域——计算机科学。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And as you switched from math to computer science, how did you think about the potential career skills and job prospects?
sentences.zh: 当你从数学转到计算机科学时，你是如何看待潜在的职业技能和就业前景的？

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, at the time, this would have been fall of 2021.
sentences.zh: 老实说，当时是2021年秋天。

sentences.en: I thought nothing of it.
sentences.zh: 我没想那么多。

sentences.en: I thought, I mean, I've been told my whole life that computer science is a good place to be in.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我一生都被告知计算机科学是一个很好的发展方向。

sentences.en: I mean, math as well, but computer science always felt stable to me.
sentences.zh: 数学也不错，但计算机科学对我来说一直感觉很稳定。

sentences.en: So, yeah, at the time, that was my mentality.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，当时我的心态就是这样。

sentences.en: And he does really, really well.
sentences.zh: 而且他表现得非常非常出色。

sentences.en: Summa cum laude, he's on the dean's liSt.
sentences.zh: 以优异成绩毕业，名列院长名单。

sentences.en: He's worked as a teaching assistant for the more basic computer science courses.
sentences.zh: 他曾担任基础计算机科学课程的助教。

sentences.en: He did all the right things.
sentences.zh: 他做的一切都是对的。

sentences.en: And yet, as he starts applying to internships, reality hits that, in fact, coding is not going to magically produce a host of job options.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他开始申请实习时，现实给了他沉重一击：编程并不会奇迹般地带来大量的工作机会。

sentences.en: Starting fall of 2023, I believe I applied to 90 positions before that summer of 2024.
sentences.zh: 从2023年秋天开始，我相信在2024年夏天之前，我申请了90个职位。

sentences.en: Probably got, I think, three or four interviews and no offers.
sentences.zh: 大概得到了三四次面试机会，但没有收到任何录用通知。

sentences.en: No offers.
sentences.zh: 没有录用通知。

sentences.en: Wait, sorry, can I just interject for a minute here?
sentences.zh: 等等，抱歉，我能插一句吗？

sentences.en: In the fall of 2023, you applied to 90 different internship programs for the next summer in tech.
sentences.zh: 在2023年秋天，你为接下来的夏天申请了90个不同的科技实习项目。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You got a couple of interviews, but no internship offers?
sentences.zh: 你参加了几次面试，但没有收到任何实习录用通知？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What kind of companies were you applying to?
sentences.zh: 你申请的是什么样的公司？

sentences.en: This was anything in Columbus, Cleveland, Pittsburgh, anything around kind of Midwest area.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布、克利夫兰、匹兹堡，中西部地区周边的任何地方。

sentences.en: Probably mid-size, I'd say.
sentences.zh: 大概是中等规模的公司吧。

sentences.en: The math he describes to you is almost comically cruel, that he doesn't get a single internship from 90 applications.
sentences.zh: 他向你描述的数字简直残酷得可笑，他申请了90个职位，竟然连一个实习机会都没得到。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The thing that's striking is many students I spoke to applied to 90, hundreds, maybe even thousands of jobs and didn't get a single offer.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊的是，我采访过的许多学生申请了90个、几百个，甚至几千个工作岗位，却连一个录用通知都没收到。

sentences.en: And neither does Nathan.
sentences.zh: Nathan也是如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, I mean, the cycle began again.
sentences.zh: 所以，循环又开始了。

sentences.en: I think I did a little less.
sentences.zh: 我想我申请的稍微少一点。

sentences.en: I think I hit 70, 71 applications during senior year, interviews for about three or four.
sentences.zh: 大四期间我投了70到71份申请，获得了三四次面试机会。

sentences.en: But this year, he actually does get one offer for a summer internship.
sentences.zh: 但今年，他确实获得了一个暑期实习的录用通知。

sentences.en: It's application development, so it's what I've been looking for for the past four years.
sentences.zh: 是应用程序开发，这正是我过去四年一直在寻找的方向。

sentences.en: And after graduating college in May, he gets this internship at a Ohio state government agency where he's developing apps.
sentences.zh: 五月份大学毕业后，他在俄亥俄州政府的一个机构获得了这份实习工作，负责开发应用程序。

sentences.en: But he does not have a full-time job offer.
sentences.zh: 但他没有获得全职工作录用通知。

sentences.en: This whole time I've been applying to jobs over the summer.
sentences.zh: 这段时间我一直在申请工作。

sentences.en: So it's just, yeah, it's just really frustrating.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的非常令人沮丧。

sentences.en: I'm curious how Nathan sees this gap that we have been talking about this entire episode between what kids like him were told about programming and coding and the reality of his situation today.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇Nathan如何看待我们在整期节目中讨论的差距，即孩子们被告知的关于编程的愿景与他今天所处的现实之间的差距。

sentences.en: You know, I asked him about it.
sentences.zh: 我问过他这个问题。

sentences.en: And he had a very nuanced view.
sentences.zh: 他有非常深刻的见解。

sentences.en: You know, he did not expect to instantly move out to Silicon Valley and land a big tech job and make a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 他并没有指望立刻搬到硅谷，找到一份大型科技公司的工作并赚大钱。

sentences.en: I think when you tell every young person for several years, computer science is the place to be, they start to believe that.
sentences.zh: 我认为当你连续几年告诉每个年轻人计算机科学是最好的选择时，他们就开始相信了。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, everybody has a computer science degree.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，每个人都有了计算机科学学位。

sentences.en: So it's very difficult to feel like you're competing against this mass quantity of people and also feel like you don't have a way to make yourself stand out.
sentences.zh: 所以很难感觉到自己是在与如此庞大的人群竞争，同时也觉得没有办法让自己脱颖而出。

sentences.en: At least for the moment, he feels like too many kids bought the tech industry marketing and decided to major in computer science.
sentences.zh: 至少目前，他觉得太多的孩子相信了科技行业的营销，决定主修计算机科学。

sentences.en: And his view is that the supply of student or recent grad programmers is now exceeding industry demand.
sentences.zh: 他的观点是，学生或应届毕业程序员的供给现在已经超过了行业需求。

sentences.en: Basically, he believes too many people did what he did.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他认为太多人做了和他一样的事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And now there's a glut.
sentences.zh: 现在供过于求了。

sentences.en: That's what he thinks.
sentences.zh: 他是这么认为的。

sentences.en: How much blame does he put on AI for what's happening?
sentences.zh: 他认为人工智能对目前发生的事情负有多少责任？

sentences.en: Nathan says he's very concerned about it.
sentences.zh: Nathan说他对此非常担心。

sentences.en: I mean, the fact that entry level and junior level positions are effectively being eliminated because companies are deciding that AI can do that work instead.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，入门级和初级职位实际上正在被淘汰，因为公司认为人工智能可以代替这些工作。

sentences.en: That's just that boggles my mind because how are you going to have senior developers if you get rid of all the junior developers?
sentences.zh: 这让我感到不可思议，因为如果你裁掉了所有的初级开发人员，以后怎么会有高级开发人员呢？

sentences.en: His view is that AI is going to increasingly be used to code and displace entry level software engineers and junior programmers.
sentences.zh: 他的观点是，人工智能将越来越多地被用于编写代码，并取代入门级软件工程师和初级程序员。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just the money.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是为了钱。

sentences.en: He wanted to be a builder, which is what the tech industry wants.
sentences.zh: 他想成为一名创造者，这正是科技行业所需要的。

sentences.en: And he was very wistful that now the AIs are going to be the creators and humans are just going to be essentially the handmaidens that steer AI coding and then check whether the AI code that was produced is correct.
sentences.zh: 他非常惆怅，因为现在人工智能将成为创造者，而人类将基本上成为引导人工智能编码，并检查生成代码是否正确的“侍从”。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's like training a whole generation of kids to be chefs to cook from scratch and then saying to them, OK,
sentences.zh: 这就像培养了一代孩子成为从零开始烹饪的厨师，然后告诉他们，好吧，

sentences.en: you're going to just be in charge of cake mixes from now on.
sentences.zh: 从现在起你们只负责使用蛋糕预拌粉。

sentences.en: Does he think that there is a career in tech for him?
sentences.zh: 他认为自己在科技行业还有职业前景吗？

sentences.en: You know, he is really interested in being a designer.
sentences.zh: 他确实对成为一名设计师非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: I've been investigating switching out of this field.
sentences.zh: 我一直在考虑转行。

sentences.en: And he's thinking about if he cannot design software, what other careers are there where he could design things?
sentences.zh: 他正在思考，如果不能设计软件，还有什么职业可以让他设计东西？

sentences.en: And that would be meaningful for him.
sentences.zh: 而且那对他来说是有意义的。

sentences.en: I took some really, really great architecture classes in undergrad.
sentences.zh: 我在本科时修过几门非常、非常棒的建筑学课程。

sentences.en: And so he's thinking about maybe going to graduate school in architecture so that he can build things, which is the thing that he feels he's good at.
sentences.zh: 所以他正在考虑去读建筑学研究生，这样他就能去建造东西了，那是他觉得自己擅长的事情。

sentences.en: He's talented and he cares about.
sentences.zh: 他很有天赋，而且也很在意这些。

sentences.en: And I think it might be a good time to pick up a secondary skill, whether that's through grad school program or even just starting an internship in a completely different field.
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在或许是个学习第二技能的好时机，无论是通过研究生项目，还是仅仅从一个完全不同的领域开始实习。

sentences.en: Mm hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没错。

sentences.en: As disheartening as Nathan's experience clearly is.
sentences.zh: 尽管内森的经历显然令人沮丧。

sentences.en: I just want to level set for a minute with you, Natasha.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莎，我想先和你统一一下认识。

sentences.en: Nathan and those like him clearly came along at a time when computer science transitioned into artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 内森和像他这样的人，显然是在计算机科学向人工智能转型的时期进入这个行业的。

sentences.en: Before they had a chance to really know that was going to happen and to train for it.
sentences.zh: 在他们有机会真正预见到这一切并为此做好准备之前。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's no AP, AI class.
sentences.zh: 学校里并没有人工智能的先修课程。

sentences.en: So I guess what I'm asking is, is this a temporary problem, one that can over time be addressed by the education system?
sentences.zh: 所以我猜我想问的是，这是一个暂时的问题吗？一个随着时间推移可以通过教育系统解决的问题？

sentences.en: So I think the answer is both yes and no.
sentences.zh: 我觉得答案既是也不是。

sentences.en: I think that computer science majors who graduated this year and last year are going to have a particularly hard time because many of them have not yet learned to use the AI coding tools that big tech companies now want software developers and software engineers to use.
sentences.zh: 我认为今年和去年毕业的计算机科学专业学生将会面临特别困难的处境，因为他们中的许多人还没有学会使用大型科技公司现在希望软件开发人员和软件工程师使用的AI编程工具。

sentences.en: So it's certainly conceivable that five years from now,
sentences.zh: 所以可以想象，五年之后，

sentences.en: when college computer science departments are teaching kids both the fundamentals of computer programming and then how to use these new coding tools,
sentences.zh: 当大学计算机科学系开始教学生计算机编程基础，以及如何使用这些新的编程工具时，

sentences.en: that computer science majors will be much more employable.
sentences.zh: 计算机科学专业的学生将会有更强的就业竞争力。

sentences.en: But I also think in the long term, it's really hard to know.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为，从长远来看，这真的很难说。

sentences.en: And so, Natasha, I wonder what you think the big lesson of this story is.
sentences.zh: 所以，娜塔莎，我想知道你认为这个故事带来的最大教训是什么。

sentences.en: I mean, superficially, perhaps, one observation I take is that tech moves a whole lot faster than our education system.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从表面上看，我观察到的一点是，科技的发展速度远快于我们的教育系统。

sentences.en: And so there's inevitably going to be a mismatch here if tech folks tell schools to prepare kids and then tech just changes and those kids are prepared for a market that no longer exists.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果科技界人士告诉学校要培养学生，而科技本身却在不断变化，导致学生们为市场准备的技能已经过时，那么这种错位是不可避免的。

sentences.en: I think that this is completely true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这完全正确。

sentences.en: And also, I think it's sort of the moral of the story.
sentences.zh: 而且，我认为这算是这个故事的寓意所在。

sentences.en: I'm working on a book right now about the decade-long push for computer science and now AI in schools.
sentences.zh: 我目前正在写一本书，关于过去十年里在学校推广计算机科学，以及现在推广人工智能的浪潮。

sentences.en: And one of the things I've learned from doing historical research is that this is a pattern of the tech industry of pushing school reforMs.
sentences.zh: 我在做历史研究时学到的一点是，这是科技行业推动学校改革的一种模式。

sentences.en: And it's always the latest hyped thing that's urgent for schools to teach.
sentences.zh: 而且总是把最新的炒作概念包装成学校急需教授的内容。

sentences.en: And schools respond.
sentences.zh: 而学校也会做出回应。

sentences.en: And we want schools to respond because we want kids to be able to use the technology of the day.
sentences.zh: 我们希望学校做出回应，因为我们希望孩子们能够使用当代的科技。

sentences.en: And we want kids to be able to learn the subjects that are the most important of the day and that help them navigate their worlds and get jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们希望孩子们能够学习当今最重要的学科，帮助他们驾驭世界并找到工作。

sentences.en: But at the same time, tech companies have outsized influence in schools.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，科技公司对学校有着过大的影响力。

sentences.en: And we have bowed to tech industry education agendas in school without a lot of public discussion or independent scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 我们在没有经过太多公众讨论或独立审查的情况下，就向科技行业的教育议程低了头。

sentences.en: And if you think about other industries, we don't let big pharma companies like Pfizer or Johnson & Johnson tell high schools what to teach in biology.
sentences.zh: 如果你想想其他行业，我们不会让辉瑞或强生这样的大型制药公司去告诉高中该教什么生物学课程。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're saying tech has a unique purchase on American education.
sentences.zh: 你是说科技行业对美国教育有着独特的掌控力。

sentences.en: Tech companies supply the laptops, the software, the email, the writing apps, the PowerPoint apps, right?
sentences.zh: 科技公司提供笔记本电脑、软件、电子邮件、写作应用、PPT应用，对吧？

sentences.en: They supply the platforms on which schools run.
sentences.zh: 他们提供了学校运行所需的平台。

sentences.en: And it gives them a unique power to then say, we are the backbone of schools.
sentences.zh: 这赋予了他们一种独特的力量，让他们可以说：我们是学校的支柱。

sentences.en: We are at the forefront innovation.
sentences.zh: 我们站在创新的最前沿。

sentences.en: And so we're going to tell you what kids need to learn.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要告诉你们孩子们需要学什么。

sentences.en: No other industry occupies that kind of powerful influence in schools.
sentences.zh: 没有其他行业在学校里拥有这种强大的影响力。

sentences.en: And I'm reporting on how some of the same tech companies that pushed for computer science are now pivoting from coding to pushing for AI education and AI tools in schools.
sentences.zh: 我正在报道一些曾经推动计算机科学的科技公司，现在是如何从编程转向推动学校里的AI教育和AI工具的。

sentences.en: And we see Microsoft just announced an effort to provide $4 billion in AI technology and training to skill students in schools and community colleges with AI.
sentences.zh: 我们看到微软刚刚宣布了一项计划，提供40亿美元的AI技术和培训，旨在为学校和社区学院的学生提供AI技能。

sentences.en: Google just announced a $1 billion commitment for a similar AI education effort.
sentences.zh: 谷歌也刚刚宣布了一项10亿美元的承诺，用于类似的AI教育工作。

sentences.en: And the crisis rhetoric is similar to the coding crusade, right?
sentences.zh: 这种危机论调和当年的编程运动如出一辙，对吧？

sentences.en: The country needs more skilled AI workers to stay competitive.
sentences.zh: 国家需要更多熟练的AI工作者来保持竞争力。

sentences.en: And kids who learn to use AI will get better job opportunities.
sentences.zh: 学会使用AI的孩子将获得更好的就业机会。

sentences.en: So it's 2010 all over again.
sentences.zh: 所以这简直是2010年的重演。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So I think we have the opportunity now to proceed more deliberately and think more clearly about what are the things that are most important for kids to learn and not so much what's best for tech companies.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们现在有机会更审慎地行事，更清晰地思考什么对孩子来说才是最重要的，而不是什么对科技公司最有利。

sentences.en: Well, Natasha, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，娜塔莎，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Always great to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你交流。

sentences.en: Natasha Singer is writing a book about all of this.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莎·辛格正在写一本关于这一切的书。

sentences.en: It's called Coding Kids, Big Tech's Battle to Remake Public Schools, and it will be published next fall.
sentences.zh: 书名是《编程的孩子：大型科技公司重塑公立学校的战争》，将于明年秋天出版。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, President Trump ordered that federal troops be sent to Portland, Oregon, to quell small protests there directed at a U.S.
sentences.zh: 周末，特朗普总统下令派遣联邦军队前往俄勒冈州波特兰市，以平息那里针对美国移民及海关执法局设施的小规模抗议活动。

sentences.en: immigration and customs enforcement facility.
sentences.zh: 此举遭到了该州州长、民主党人蒂娜·科泰克的反对，

sentences.en: The move has been opposed by the state's governor, Democrat Tina Kotek,
sentences.zh: 她表示自己曾告诉总统及其国土安全部长，让他们不要插手该市事务。

sentences.en: who said that she had told both the president and his secretary of Homeland Security to stay out of the city.
sentences.zh: 这里没有发生叛乱。

sentences.en: There is no insurrection.
sentences.zh: 这里没有对国家安全构成威胁。

sentences.en: There is no threat to national security.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要城市不需要军队进驻。

sentences.en: And there is no need for military troops in our major city.
sentences.zh: 军人应该致力于应对真正的紧急情况。

sentences.en: Military service members should be dedicated to real emergencies.
sentences.zh: 针对波特兰移民及海关执法局办公室的抗议活动已经持续了几个月，很少有超过二十四名示威者参加，

sentences.en: The protests against an ICE office in Portland have occurred for several months, rarely attracting more than two dozen demonstrators,
sentences.zh: 期间包括抗议者与警察之间发生的短暂冲突，其中一些涉及催泪瓦斯。

sentences.en: and have included brief skirmishes between protesters and police, some of them involving tear gas.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，移民及海关执法局逮捕了爱荷华州得梅因市公立学校系统的负责人伊恩·罗伯茨，声称罗伯茨多年来一直非法滞留美国，并无视了先前存在的驱逐令。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, ICE has arrested the superintendent of the public school system in Des Moines, Iowa, Ian Roberts, claiming that Roberts has been in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在他被捕后，得梅因学校董事会表示对罗伯茨的法律身份并不知情，并迅速投票决定让他停职。

sentences.en: illegally for years and had ignored a pre-existing deportation order.
sentences.zh: 最后，纽约市市长埃里克·亚当斯在距离选举日仅剩五周时，结束了他陷入困境的连任竞选。

sentences.en: After his arrest, Des Moines' school board said it was unaware of Roberts' legal status and quickly voted to put him on leave.
sentences.zh: 他在一段视频中承认，去年他因联邦腐败指控被起诉——尽管特朗普总统后来撤销了这些指控——这损害了他选民心目中的形象。

sentences.en: Finally, New York City's mayor, Eric Adams, is ending his beleaguered campaign for re-election, just five weeks before Election Day.
sentences.zh: 最近的民调显示，亚当斯在竞选中排名第四，仅获得7%的支持率，选举将于11月4日举行。

sentences.en: In a video, he acknowledged that his indictment on federal corruption charges last year, charges that President Trump later dropped, had hurt his image with voters.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由戴安娜·阮、里基·诺韦茨基、迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊和玛丽·威尔逊制作。

sentences.en: Recent polls showed Adams in fourth place in the race, winning just 7% of the vote, which will be held on November 4th.
sentences.zh: 由马克·乔治和帕特里夏·威兰斯剪辑，包含马里昂·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔的音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Diana Nguyen, Rikki Nowetsky, Michael Simon-Johnson, and Mary Wilson.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George and Patricia Willans, contains music from Marion Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡得不省人事。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 我是指他们对光线有什么要求，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require, because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上，或者你喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
